name: Diver's Camp
desc:
**Diver's Camp** is an area in [The Depths](location:the_depths). It is a landmark in the Celtor Wastes, and is a campsite set up by the Divers for their Apprentice Divers.

The Camp is found straight and to the left of the District of Commerce Ramp Gate. It is protected by [The Divers](faction:the_divers), so if any hostile monster wanders in, several of the Divers will jump to attack it. However, do be warned that the low-level Apprentice Divers are relatively weak and therefore cannot hold against the monsters on their own.

This is an area intended to be used for players who have drowned and cannot reach [Castle Light](location:castle_light) because of it.

The location of the Diver's Camp on the map.
